disad.notes: The weakest Attitude About Lethal Force Disadvantage, this one indicates that the character is willing to use lethal force when necessary -- but that is still very, very rare in the character's opinion.  The character does have moral objections to killing, but realizes that sometimes it may be necessary.  Such a character is willing to fight and do injury, but in a moment where the decision is "Kill/Don't Kill", this character will always choose "Don't Kill", unless the situation is such that not killing is clearly the worse of two evils.  At that point, the character will not hesitate before killing.  In four color superhero games, this Disadvantage should be restricted to Villains.  In more lethal settings, such as military campaigns, or post-holocaust scenarios, this might be the default attitude for "good guy" characters.  In such cases, the GM should watch the player like a hawk to make sure the Disadvantage is being roleplayed correctly.  It should not be used as an excuse for a murderous character.
